//: One source of truth for the per-plugin CI lanes. Read by integrations/tooling/lanes.mjs, which .github/workflows/ci.yml and integrations/tooling/run-lane.mjs both go through. See integrations/PARALLEL_LANES.md.
sharedIndexNote: Port block for the CI jobs that are not a plugin lane — the hosting-surface check and the generic plugin-system e2e suite. A reserved index rather than a separate fixed block, so there is one port formula and lanes.test.mjs can prove it collides with nothing. No lane may take index 9.

lanes.note: No lane job, on purpose. money has an atomicCertification block, so the unsharded certification step in shared-checks already runs exactly its typecheck (tsconfig.json) and unit (vitest.config.ts) on every integrations/** change, plus bundle reproducibility; typecheck/unit tiers here would only repeat that. Add a tier once money has a server-dependent test. moneybird is listed but not consumed: integrations/money/ is an MT940/camt.053 uploader with no Moneybird code, and the moneybird catalog entry has no package in this repo. With no tier, no mock proxy is started for this lane. A future Moneybird fixture and its recorder go in integrations/money/fixtures/moneybird/ (plugin-specific files stay in the plugin folder); integrations/localthought/fixtures/index.mjs registers it by importing ../../money/fixtures/moneybird/scenario.mjs. See PARALLEL_LANES.md, Still open.

lanes.quarantined: e2e: the [data-integration=notion] card the spec starts from was removed upstream (atomic-server 4bab16ee6). Re-add "e2e" to tiers once #68 gives it an entry point. The spec list below is kept so that is a one-word change.
lanes.note: platforms is deliberately empty: neither tier talks to the lane's mock proxy. The e2e spec points integration-proxy-url at its own https://notion-proxy.test origin and fulfils /catalog and /proxy/notion/** with page.route; the live tier stubs fetch in-process. Moving onto the shared mock would need a recorded fixtures/notion/, a test-control channel to the out-of-process mock (the spec revokes access, asserts PATCH bodies and edits the remote page mid-test) and a real /connect handoff instead of the seeded fixture-code. See integrations/PARALLEL_LANES.md and issue #47.

lanes.quarantined: e2e: the setup dialog needs BrowserIntegrations.describe(), which neither side has since the WASM bridge was removed; blocked on #52 (move LocalThought setup/sync to reflector). Re-add "e2e" to tiers then. With no tiers this lane produces no job, like money.

lanes.note: No e2e tier. The upstream Clockify tests (plugins.spec.ts's pair and clockify-import.spec.ts) were deleted in atomic-server 4bab16ee6, which the pin includes, together with the UI they drove, so there was nothing to move (#44). A new e2e tier needs a new entry point, most likely #20's timesheets drive app once atomic-server#1624 and an install flow exist.
